newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo rubber futures end mixed, nearbys lower.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo rubber futures end mixed, nearbys lower.

text.p: Tokyo rubber futures ended mixed on Friday, as nearby months fell, depressed by near-term oversupply trends, traders said.
Prices ranged from 6.0 yen per kg lower to 0.5 yen firmer. Benchmark September was up 0.4 yen at 136.3 yen.

A perception there will be a large number of deliveries at the spot expiry next week, stimulated heavy long-liquidation especially in nearby months. "Sentiment remains bearish. The spot April contract is likely to probe the downside support at 120.0 yen in the near future," one trader said.
